title: Sequential Borrow Scopes
goal: Order operations so the RefCell write guard is dropped before reading.

source.attribution: adapted from Interior Mutability: Borrow Scopes

hints: The write guard must be acquired before pushing into the vector.
The write guard must be dropped before calling borrow() to avoid a dynamic borrow conflict.
explanation: To mutate and then read a `RefCell`, you must release the mutable guard before acquiring a shared guard. Placing `cell.borrow().len()` before `drop(guard)` triggers a dynamic borrow conflict and panics at runtime with `AlreadyBorrowed`. Executing the read before the write returns the old length before the push, causing test failures.
